## Personality

Jane Andrews is known for being sensible, steady, and unflappable, with nerves that remain entirely unrattled. Driven by the financial compensation of the profession, her goal is to devote her entire life to teaching and never marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018)_

## History

Jane Andrews attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers. On the final day of term under Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), Jane became so emotional during his farewell speech that, lacking a handkerchief of her own, she was forced to borrow one from her brother. She later attended a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), traveling to the event and sharing supper afterward with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After pursuing further education at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Jane visited Anne's boarding room with Ruby and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) to share news about the Avery scholarship and later to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are long-time school friends and Queen's classmates who share creative and academic pursuits. Jane joins the story club proposed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), visits her during her recovery from a broken ankle, and rides with her to events like the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), +10 more_

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

### [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)

They both join Anne's story club and later attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where they visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans.
